verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; budget is being corrected now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 121 leads at $11.43 per lead on a total spend of $1,383.45 — a solid baseline. This week, however, daily spend fell to roughly $27 and lead flow thinned significantly, with two days producing no leads at all. The drop traces directly to a budget pullback that went too far; cost per lead improved, but not at the expense of volume we're comfortable accepting. Spend is being stepped back up to restore daily lead flow, and you should see volume recover in the coming days.
